grid: 100 log steps per decade from10 tolimit, exact powers10 included; OLS logW/logX on [1e3,Xmax] unless specified
F2_convention: Li(x)=Ei(log x) for x>1, Re Li(x^rho) means Re Ei(rho log x) by continuation along positive real log x, NOT resetting principal log(x^rho). No arbitrary constant subtraction. Positive generators are the unique roots Pi_a(x)=k, k=1,2,...
F2_density_proof: Pi_a derivative=(1-2a*x^(-1/4)*cos(10 log x))/log x >=(1-2a)/log x>0 for x>1; Pi_a -> -infinity at1+ because1-2a>0, ->infinity asx->infinity. Thus unique quantiles exist. Check numerical positivity too after prereg.
F2_analytic_caveat: Continuous log Euler factor has a*log(s-rho0)+a*log(s-conj(rho0))-log(s-1). Quantile error O1 and higher prime powers are analytic for Re s>1/2 locally. For noninteger a=.05,.2 this is a fractional branch singularity, NOT an ordinary meromorphic zero of integral order. The source definitions remain unchanged; do not label an observed conventional zero.
F2_leading_W_before_run: If inverse zeta local factor is C*(s-rho0)^(-a), its Mellin inversion gives C*x^rho0*(log x)^(a-1)/(rho0*Gamma(a)) plus conjugate. Squaring/dividing byx^2 and integrating gives leading oscillatory envelope K*X^(2*.75-1)*(log X)^(2*a-3). For a=.2 log slope is .5-2.6/logX (~.274 to.339 on1e5..1e7). Constants, baseline and cross terms can dominate finite range; this is asymptotic leading analysis, not a guaranteed finite lower bound.

J3_band.rule: PASS iff measured OLS logW/logX lies in closed band; report a0 slope and difference; a failed empirical band is a failed judge and is never repaired by changing band after data.

F3: Round F2 generators to nearest integer (half upward); preserve generator identities and all multiplicities even when generators coincide. Reject generator<=1 as undefined infinite-semigroup case, report model failure rather than silently drop it.
W: Exact step integration with Kahan; report numerical precision, not interval claims. T0 baseline reuse allowed, independently reproduce requested checkpoints. T2 uses normalized tau(n)/n^(11/2) before inversion. F1 periodic a(1)=1. Raw W drives all predictions; no fitted linear-bias subtraction. Report M/x; secondary normalization only if a nonzero analytic residue at s=1 is established, otherwise natural sqrt(x) normalization already present in samples.
P1: Separate rho_hat for each F2/F3 system, least-squares zero-intercept fit N~rho*x on fixed log-grid [1e4,1e5]: sum x*N/sum x^2. Freeze before evaluating higher x. Report residual/sqrtx and residual/x^.75. Not asymptotic rho proof.
P2: For moduli3,4,5,6 report every generator residue count and (C_r-C/m)/sqrt(C), with multiplicities of rounded generator labels. Scalar detection probe =sqrt(sum_r(C_r-C/m)^2/C), one scalar per modulus. T0 true-prime reference also recorded.
P3: For each integer-supported system sum_{n=1}^{floorX-1} b(n)b(n+1)/X (both arguments inside X); coefficient-support adjacent fraction counts b(n)!=0 andb(n+1)!=0 divided byfloorX-1. Record numerical-zero convention for real coefficients. For F3 also report generalized-integer membership support (N_delta>0), distinct from nonzero aggregated b.
P4: F3 missing fraction=sum1_{N_delta(n)=0}/floorX, multiplicity-excess fraction=sum max(N_delta(n)-1,0)/floorX for1<=n<=floorX. Unit counted.
P5: F1 mean absolute a(mn)-a(m)a(n) over ALL ORDERED coprime pairs1<=m,n<=floorX. Exact finite pair counts via Mobius residue-class summation or equivalent; no convenience random pair sampling. a is original DH a, not inverse b.
noise_rule: For each scalar probe independently and each X>=1e3 use preceding100 baseline-a0 log-grid values (exclude current point; one decade); subtract their OLS affine fit versus logX; sigma=sqrt(sum residual^2/(100-2)). Noise=max(sigma,64*binary64_epsilon*max(1,maxabs baseline window)). This is deterministic shifted-window fluctuation, not stochastic standard error. Compare pointwise abs(probe_a005(X)-probe_a0(X)) >5*noise.
X_det: Smallest grid X>=1e3 satisfying strict5-noise rule; no persistence filter. Return NOT_DETECTED_UP_TO_XMAX or NOT_APPLICABLE rather than infinity as a measured value. All declared scalar components are reported; B3 uses earliest eligible blockB component for F3.

predictions_verbatim.B1: T1 and T2 have max W ≤ 1 on the grid and slope ≤ 0.1 — 0.75
predictions_verbatim.B3: some block-B probe detects F3(0.05) vs F3(0) at X_det at least 10× smaller than W does — 0.35
predictions_verbatim.B5: T2 W within a factor 5 of T0 W at common X — 0.5

prediction_rules.B1: both T1,T2 maxW over entire grid10..limit<=1 AND each slope[1e3,limit]<=.1
prediction_rules.B3: HIT if a defined F3 blockB detector D exists and W detected at>=10D; also HIT if W undetected throughXmax and Xmax>=10D. Otherwise MISS within tested horizon, not asymptotic disproof.

J2: T0 M powers and W1e7 exactly reproduce predecessor printed value with same kernel; independently trial-factor T1 to50000
J4: F3 independently enumerate exponent vectors to500, preserve duplicate generators; also verify inversion convolution on small true systems
